entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: isometric empty shelf sprite atlas for the supplied cozy pixel-art Godot shop game.
Input images 1-4 are the existing same shelf, in its four numbered views. Use their visible perspective, silhouette, board positions, heavy dark brown outline, chunky discrete pixels, teal details and warm wood palette as style references.
Primary task: produce an atlas of sixteen EMPTY shelf bodies, FOUR columns and FOUR rows. Generously transparent spacing between all sixteen independent sprites, no connecting pixels, no floor, shadows, labels, text, grid or decorations.
Columns, repeated identically in every row:
1 front view matching image1 (open shelving on broad left visible plane, solid side on right),
2 front view matching image2 (open shelving on broad right visible plane, solid side on left),
3 rear view matching image3 (solid rear on broad left plane, side on right),
4 rear view matching image4 (solid rear on broad right plane, side on left).
Rows:
1 improvised salvaged wood shelf: plain brown planks, small uneven repairs and two modest rope ties, slight teal reclaimed trim, structurally intact.
2 crafted wood shelf: tidy warm brown frame, natural wood shelves and muted teal edge trim.
3 reinforced wood shelf: same warm wood body with iron corner brackets and sturdy dark gray corner fittings.
4 modern convenience store shelf: same scale, off-white steel boards and uprights, muted teal price-strip edges, dark brown contour pixels to match existing art. No writing on price strips.
All sixteen are the same small 1x1 tile footprint and overall height. Three horizontal storage board planes at identical locations. Frontal shelves MUST contain NO bottles, fruit, cartons, boxes, food, packaged goods or signs. Back views MUST be closed wooden/metal backing, never accidentally show stock through the back. Keep empty dark inner cavities and readable board edges.
Orthographic 2:1 isometric pixel art, no perspective convergence, no smooth photographic texture. Keep coarse individual pixel clusters like the references. Transparent background, opaque sprite pixels, no anti-alias halos. Leave sufficient empty border around every sprite so none overlaps another cell.
This is a production sprite atlas, not a rendered presentation or drawing of a shop. Preserve the reference design's small compact proportions.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: EMPTY storage rack body atlas for the supplied cozy isometric pixel-art Godot shop game.
Input images1-3 are actual current storage rack sprites (normal, wood, steel), image4 is the new matching empty sales shelf atlas, which provides palette and pixel contour style.
Produce twelve separate storage rack sprites on genuinely transparent background, 4 columns and 3 rows with generous empty gutters.
Row1: warm brown normal rack with subtle gray iron uprights and teal end caps; looks like reference1.
Row2: rustic warm wood storage rack with modest rope bindings; looks like reference2 with goods removed.
Row3: modern pale gray/off-white steel rack with muted teal end caps; looks like reference3.
Each rack is 2 tiles long by 1 tile deep. SAME compact long footprint, same overall height across all twelve. Thin uprights, THREE empty load-bearing shelf planes plus one top cap; no goods, boxes, tools, bags, bottles, signs or symbols. The storage levels must have generous clear visible empty areas for separately drawn goods. Crossbraces only on the rear plane, not covering the open front plane.
Column1: broad front open shelf plane slants down to right, narrow side visible on right (same angle as image1).
Column2: broad front open shelf plane slants down to left, narrow side visible on left.
Column3: rear view corresponding to column1, show rear diagonal crossbrace, shelves remain visible through the back.
Column4: rear view corresponding to column2, show rear diagonal crossbrace.
Orthographic 2:1 isometric view, no convergence, no photographic rendering. Match the existing small sprite scale and chunky limited-palette pixel clusters, dark brown contour and teal hardware. No anti-alias halos, no floor, no shadows, no grid, no labels/text, no checkerboard.
All twelve pieces isolated with large transparent margins, no overlap between cells. Preserve the original game art feel, not a different asset collection.
entries.cleanup_prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit only the background of this exact twelve-piece storage rack atlas. Remove ALL dark brown/gray/teal backdrop, vignette, glow, shadows and colored atmospheric haze between and behind the sprites. The entire canvas outside the solid rack pixel clusters MUST be truly transparent alpha=0, including open spaces between all posts and all shelf boards. Preserve all twelve rack bodies exactly, same size, locations, colors, contour and pixel details; preserve the same four-column three-row layout. Do not add labels, goods or other objects. Do not render a checkered transparency pattern. Keep the shelf board planes opaque. Transparent-background isolated sprite sheet.
